description: Scale, move, rotate and flip each item around its own reference point (Object > Transform > Transform Each). With random, each item gets a random amount between none and the value given. With copy, transformed copies are made and the originals stay

apply.description: What to transform: both (default), objects only, or pattern fills only (Transform panel menu)

copy.description: Transform copies, leaving the originals. Default false

moveX.description: Horizontal move in points, right positive. Default 0

moveY.description: Vertical move in points, down positive. Default 0

origin.description: Reference point each item transforms around. Default center

random.description: Random amounts per item. Default false

scaleCorners.description: Scale live corner radii with the object (Scale Corners). Default: the current setting

scaleStrokes.description: Scale stroke weights. Default: the Scale Strokes & Effects preference

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: transform_each
title: Transform Each
